unresolved_decisions: Choose a Project Management System or explicitly skip PM integration.
Choose and identity-verify the Development AI agent pool available in the current host before privileged worker dispatch.
Decide whether to apply recommended GitHub Rules; repository plan currently cannot expose rulesets without an eligible GitHub plan/public visibility.

notes: PHASE-000 foundation is complete and PHASE-001 development is active. WU-002 remains in progress because its acceptance criterion is not yet satisfied: approved desktop calling applications have not consumed processed/bypass audio through an installed OS-visible VSN virtual microphone. The verified Windows foundation includes Rust audio contracts and bounded queues, deterministic device selection/reselection, bounded stream recovery, IAudioClient3 planning, event-driven WASAPI capture, sample decode/reframing, CaptureRuntime reopen recovery, IMMNotificationClient delivery, bounded virtual-mic staging/output, Rust/C++ transport ABI, aligned Interlocked cursor publication, deterministic shared-region geometry, real user-mode section mapping and a WDK-buildable KMDF control driver with a secure driver-owned section lifecycle. The original caller-supplied-section CONNECT assumption was replaced by driver-owned CONNECT v2 in merge 3953069f468c46d744f30625b3696e5b12f03a77 after AI Native run 34537871677 and Windows run 34537871806 passed. The KMDF control-driver slice merged as b2761ad400d92c1d810751fabcf4b071a40dfb9c after AI Native run 34539554036 and Windows run 34539554115 passed. A concurrency review then identified that global producer/consumer cursors alone could not prove that a PCM slot was not being overwritten while the kernel copied it during an overrun. The transport protocol was therefore advanced to version 2 with one aligned 64-bit seqlock-style stamp per PCM slot. The shared region now places the slot-stamp array at offset 128 and audio at offset 192; the 48 kHz mono F32 10 ms four-frame reference mapping is 7,872 bytes. Producer helpers mark a slot writing before PCM mutation and publish a stable sequence stamp only after the complete frame write. ConsumeOneRingFrame uses the immutable CONNECT-time ProtocolHeader retained by the driver, normalizes overrun cursors with exact drop accounting, emits fresh silence on underrun without advancing the consumer, validates the target slot stamp before and after copying PCM, rejects a concurrently reused/torn slot without advancing the consumer and has no unbounded retry loop. The same helper is compiled and linked inside the real WDK KMDF target. AI Native Quality Gates run 34541120876 and Windows Audio Validation run 34541120903 both passed on implementation head 7948c1dc31a05fc5688d9d2b7f0da8d00605037d; Windows passed Rust compile/Clippy/tests, pinned WDK restore, KMDF .sys build/WDK validation and the expanded native C++ suite including the deliberate concurrent-slot-reuse race. This slice merged as 9c57207482bdc20ca5dc70a06cbb43c0cfa86741. This proves a race-safe shared-ring consumer contract compiled in the kernel build, not a WaveRT/PortCls audio endpoint. Still pending are a minimal WaveRT/PortCls capture endpoint and topology, audio-engine stream/position/notification integration that calls the verified consumer, INF/package installation and test signing on a controlled Windows machine, endpoint enumeration and runtime DeviceIoControl evidence, least-privilege non-admin broker/interface policy, processed/bypass audio reaching approved calling applications, physical-device recovery evidence, hardware CPU/latency/jitter/deadline measurements, and production signing/update/uninstall/rollback verification. The next valid WU-002 action is to add the minimal WDK PortCls/WaveRT virtual-microphone capture endpoint/topology and bind its stream-copy boundary to the verified guarded ring consumer without claiming OS-visible endpoint completion until build/package/install/enumeration/runtime evidence exists. Paid provider usage, proprietary model training, production credentials/cloud spend and production deployment remain subject to applicable provider/data/compute/release gates.
